15.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT w."Region Name" AS rn, w.Year AS yr, 100.0*w."Industrial Water Consumption (100 million m³)"/w."Total Water Consumption (100 million m³) " AS x, e."Per capita GDP (yuan/person)" AS y FROM sheet1 w JOIN economic_indicator_data e ON w.Year=e.Year AND w."Region Code"=e."Region Code" WHERE w."Region Name"!='China'), prov AS (SELECT rn, AVG(y) AS avg_g, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2003 THEN x END) AS s03, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2010 THEN x END) AS s10, MAX(CASE WHEN yr=2018 THEN x END) AS s18 FROM base GROUP BY rn) SELECT CASE WHEN avg_g<15000 THEN 'low(<15k)' WHEN avg_g<25000 THEN 'mid(15-25k)' ELSE 'high(>25k)' END AS tier, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(s03),2) AS avg_s03, ROUND(AVG(s10),2) AS avg_s10, ROUND(AVG(s18),2) AS avg_s18, ROUND(AVG(s18-s03),2) AS avg_chg_pp FROM prov GROUP BY tier ORDER BY tier
